schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE EMPLOYEE (
    EMPID INT,
    NAME VARCHAR(255),
    SUPERVISOR INT,
    SALARY INT,
    PRIMARY KEY (EMPID),
    CHECK (EMPID <> SUPERVISOR),
    CHECK (SALARY >= 0)
);

CREATE TABLE BONUS (
    EMPID INT,
    BONUS INT,
    PRIMARY KEY (EMPID),
    FOREIGN KEY (EMPID) REFERENCES EMPLOYEE(EMPID),
    CHECK (BONUS >= 0)
);
